The query ranks Montgomery census tracts by total 2025 building permit counts from pre-aggregated tract counts, joining tract names and retaining geoid for mapping.
sql:
WITH pc AS (
  SELECT geoid, n AS permit_count
  FROM fw_pg.tract_counts
  WHERE run_id = 'r_20261024_618a0b'
    AND source = 'm1_city'
    AND grp = 'all'
)
SELECT t.name,
       pc.permit_count,
       t.geoid
FROM fw_pg.tracts t
JOIN pc ON t.geoid = pc.geoid
ORDER BY pc.permit_count DESC, t.name
LIMIT 200
